description: Matières résiduelles - Matières acceptées is a dataset listed in Données Québec open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Sherbrooke. Liste des matières résiduelles acceptées par type de collecte. Basé sur le guide de gestion des matières résiduelles, ce jeu de données est un outil facilitant le tri des matières résiduelles, de façon à ce que chaque matière se trouve dans le bon bac ! Coverage: Québec. The portal files it under the publisher Ville de Sherbrooke. Its tags are Sherbrooke, bois, carton, collecte, compostage. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV, JSON, XLS, XML. The portal shows 2024-04-18 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Attribution (CC-BY 4.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-quebec-portal.
